hook.en: Accounts are closed and profits distributed. Then someone notices interest on capital was never allowed. Do we redo the whole year?
hook.kn: ಖಾತೆಗಳು ಮುಕ್ತಾಯವಾಗಿ ಲಾಭ ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ನಂತರ ಬಂಡವಾಳದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ನೀಡಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಗೊತ್ತಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಡೀ ವರ್ಷ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೇ?

objectives.en: Prepare an adjustment table for omitted items

narration.en: Accounts are closed and profits distributed. Then someone notices interest on capital was never allowed. Do we redo the whole year? No — one adjustment entry is enough.
narration.kn: ಖಾತೆಗಳು ಮುಕ್ತಾಯವಾಗಿ ಲಾಭ ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ನಂತರ ಬಂಡವಾಳದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ನೀಡಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಗೊತ್ತಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಡೀ ವರ್ಷ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೇ? ಇಲ್ಲ — ಒಂದು ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ನಮೂದು ಸಾಕು.

body.en: List what each partner should have been credited (for example, omitted interest on capital) and debited (omitted interest on drawings). The net omitted amount would have reduced or increased the profit already distributed, so reverse it in the profit sharing ratio. The net figure for each partner shows who is to be credited and who debited; one entry between partners' capital (or current) accounts corrects everything.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಪಾಲುದಾರನಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ ಮತ್ತು ಖರ್ಚು ಆಗಬೇಕಾಗಿದ್ದ ಮೊತ್ತಗಳನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಹಂಚಿದ ಲಾಭವನ್ನು ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಿ. ನಿವ್ವಳ ಮೊತ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ಖಾತೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ನಮೂದು ಸಾಕು.

points.en: Credit omitted interest on capital / salary
Reverse the net amount in profit sharing ratio

problem.en: A and B share profits 3:2 with capitals ₹1,00,000 and ₹50,000. After the accounts were closed, it was found that interest on capital at 10% p.a. was not allowed. Pass the adjustment entry.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A and B share profits 3:2 with capitals ₹1,00,000 and ₹50,000. After the accounts were closed, it was found that interest on capital at 10% p.a. was not allowed. Pass the adjustment entry.

heading.en: Net columns must add to zero

body.en: In the adjustment table, the net column always totals zero: what one partner gains, the others lose. Use this to check your table.

homework.en: Make an adjustment table when salary of ₹12,000 to one partner was omitted (two partners, equal shares).

narration.en: Recap. Omitted items are corrected by one adjustment entry, not by redoing accounts. Reverse the net omitted amount in the profit sharing ratio. The net effect column always totals zero.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಬಿಟ್ಟುಹೋದ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ನಮೂದಿನಿಂದ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿ. ನಿವ್ವಳ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಲಾಭ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಿ. ನಿವ್ವಳ ಪರಿಣಾಮದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಶೂನ್ಯ.
